StudentAccount.title: StudentAccount
StudentAccount.description: Core student hostel mess account tracking monthly 60-token base allowance, rollover tokens (capped at 10), skip refunds, live balance, and consumption counters.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the student owner.

fullName.description: Full display name of the resident student.

hostelBlock.description: Hostel residence hall or wing name.

currentMonth.description: Active billing cycle in YYYY-MM format.

monthlyAllowance.description: Total opening monthly credit (60 base tokens + rolloverTokens from previous month, max 70).

rolloverTokens.description: Unused tokens rolled over from the previous month, strictly capped at 10 (0 to 10).

tokenBalance.description: Remaining spendable mess tokens in the current cycle (never below 0).

tokensUsed.description: Cumulative tokens redeemed for meals during the current billing month.

tokensRefunded.description: Cumulative tokens refunded from valid meal skips (floor(baseCost / 2)) this month.

mealsLoggedCount.description: Total meal redemption transactions logged this month.

guestMealsCount.description: Total guest meal transactions logged this month.

skipsLoggedCount.description: Total valid meal skips logged before the 8 PM previous-day cutoff.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the student account was initialized.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last meal deduction, skip refund, or rollover.

MealLog.title: MealLog
MealLog.description: Immutable ledger record of a hostel meal redemption OR a validated pre-8PM previous-day meal skip refund.

id.description: Unique identifier for the ledger entry.

studentUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the student who logged the entry.

studentId.description: Hostel roll number of the student.

entryKind.description: Whether this ledger record is a meal consumption or a valid meal skip.

isGuestMeal.description: Whether the meal includes the 2x Guest Meal multiplier (false for skips).

tokenCost.description: Deducted tokens for a meal (0 for a skip).

refundTokens.description: Refunded tokens for a valid skip: floor(baseCost / 2) (0 for Breakfast, 1 for Lunch/Dinner; 0 for regular meal).

targetMealDate.description: Target calendar date of the meal or skipped meal in YYYY-MM-DD format.

balanceBefore.description: Student token balance immediately prior to this transaction.

balanceAfter.description: Student token balance immediately following this transaction (strictly >= 0).

diningCounter.description: Mess hall line or skip cutoff verification tag.

notes.description: Optional dietary note, guest name, or skip reason.

billingMonth.description: Billing cycle identifier in YYYY-MM format.

loggedAtIso.description: Simulated or live ISO-8601 timestamp when the action was logged.

createdAt.description: Immutable server timestamp of ledger creation.

MessForecast.title: MessForecast
MessForecast.description: Admin daily hostel dining forecast aggregating enrolled students who have not skipped plus expected guest meals, flagging warnings above 120 meals.

forecastDate.description: Target forecast date in YYYY-MM-DD format.

enrolledStudents.description: Total active hostel residents registered for dining.

studentsSkipped.description: Number of students who logged a valid pre-8PM skip for tomorrow.

studentsAttending.description: Students who have not skipped (enrolledStudents - studentsSkipped).

updatedByUid.description: UID of the admin who published or updated the forecast.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the forecast update.

/students/{studentUid}.description: Primary student mess account document indexed by Firebase Auth UID.

/students/{studentUid}/mealLogs/{logId}.description: Subcollection of immutable meal token redemptions and skip refunds belonging to a student.

/forecasts/{forecastDate}.description: Admin tomorrow meal forecast documents indexed by YYYY-MM-DD date.
